qualification: Proved on in-memory ledgers (the job authority's statements included), the real probe and real repository inputs. No database, object store, processor, dispatcher loop or served HTTP walk was run.
defect: Since ZJ1 the ZIP's own item said '<N> map layers in this ZIP are taken in as their own files: ...' while its intake-zip-layers job was only queued, and a failed job appended ZJ1's D5 sentence after those words, so the item said both.
decisions: D1 intake-draft.ts zipParentWords takes a stage: 'taken' (ZF2b's sentence, the default), 'taking' ('<N> map layers in this ZIP are being taken in as their own files: <names>.', one layer 'is being taken in as its own file') or { stopped } (ZJ1's D5 sentence in place of the layers' sentence). The same listWords budgets (800 for layers, 900 for the 'Not taken in' tail) hold in every stage; the tail stays because those members are not taken in at any stage.

D2 intake-zip-layers.ts zipParentStageTx reads the archive item's stored card and rewrites only its limit_reason through writeIntakeDraftTx (an equal write publishes nothing). It runs in queueZipLayersTx's transaction after the job is registered ('taking'), in acceptUspJobAttempt's validator transaction ('taken'), and in stoppedTx for a claimed or unclaimed failure ({ stopped: D5 }). No read path or Studio change.

D2 a re-enrolment while a job is queued or running: ZF2's settlement in the same publish transaction writes ZF2b's words first, so queueZipLayersTx writes 'taking' again before returning null; before ZW1 it returned null and the words regressed to 'taken in'.
D3 when no job is queued (no layer waiting, or a shapefile ZIP), queueZipLayersTx writes nothing and ZF2b's words stand.
